name: Aldenham Country Park Playgrounds
description: An adventure playground plus the Aldenham Country Playground, a specialist play space for children and young people with special needs, with sensory play. Playgrounds open at weekends and daily in school holidays and half terms; booking ahead is recommended. Parts are being refurbished.
